summary: TypeSpec conformance engine with Frictionless-aligned transform pipeline. Builds column-level expressions for missingValues null sentinels, trueValues/falseValues boolean casting, numeric parsing (decimalChar/groupChar/bareNumber), temporal format parsing (strptime), categories casting, list delimiter parsing, and type coercion. Enforces fieldsMatch modes (exact/equal/subset/superset/partial/open). Returns ConformResult with expressions, renamed sources, and metadata. Used by ConformRelNode at compile time.

extension_points: Transform pipeline stages are composable — new Frictionless constraints map to new pipeline stages
lifecycle_notes: 2026-05 major rearchitecture: Relation.conform() now defers to ConformRelNode, which calls apply_conform() at compile time
Full Frictionless transform pipeline added: missingValues, trueValues/falseValues, numeric parsing, temporal parsing, categories, list delimiters
fieldsMatch enforcement with 6 modes: exact, equal, subset, superset, partial, open
fieldsMatch defaults to 'open' when unset (matching Frictionless spec)
risks: Transform pipeline ordering matters — missingValues must run before type casting
Ibis backend has known limitation with coalesce type strictness in null_fill scenarios
